correctness.rationale: The final seven-file package was read by exact frozen Git blob identities, and the seven tree entries independently recompute assigned tree SHA. Assuming the cited Galgano--Gesmundo--Keneshlou blow-up and contraction dictionary for the complex normal surface, canonical classes on the resolution S are -K_S=3H-ΣE=2H+B, B=H-ΣE with B²=1-κ and (-K_S)²=9-κ. The regular case contracts B and the crepant (-2)-strings; adjunction gives discrepancy a=(3-κ)/(κ-1), hence f^*(-K_Y)=Q=2H+2B/(κ-1), Q²=4κ/(κ-1). For singular pencils the B curve survives, giving (-K_Y)·C∞=3-κ and the exact nef threshold κ≤3. For any other irreducible nonexceptional curve Γ, H·Γ=d≥1 and B·Γ≥0 (distinct effective curves on a smooth surface, equivalently successive infinitely-near Bezout), so both 2H+B and 2H+2B/(κ-1) have strictly positive intersections. For chain curves A_j=E_j-E_{j+1}, the intersections are zero except on terminal exceptional curves, where 1 or 2/(κ-1); retained intermediate sizes are precisely the non-contracted null curves. This verifies all nef/ample boundaries and both self-intersection formulas; singular bigness follows because -K_S=2H+B, with H nef big and B effective even if (-K)^2<0. For κ≥3, -K_S=Q+βB with β=(κ-3)/(κ-1)≥0, Q nef and Q·B=0, giving Zariski decomposition, P²=Q². The all-maximal-block regular pencil has the same blow-up clusters and its morphism contracts exactly the Q-null configuration, so the induced anticanonical morphism is the stated abstract core model by uniqueness of the contraction. For singular κ=0,1 no division by κ-1 is needed and -K is ample; regular κ≥2 follows from genuine 2D pencil. Independent rational tests cover 20,479 distinct ordered maximal-length/eigenvalue/retained-size patterns for κ=2..10, verifying intersections, Q decomposition and null conditions, not all plane curves. Source paper itself could not be read in full, so the asserted resolution/dictionary remains an explicitly cited external theorem premise, not newly independently certified.

originality.rationale: A directly matching published mathematical record dated 2026-10-25, Weak log del Pezzo and anticanonical classification of Schubert surfaces of matrix pencils, was read in full. Its theorem covers exactly the same normal matrix-pencil Schubert surfaces, definitions of κ and distinct Jordan sizes, every regular and singular nef/ample boundary, anticanonical squares 4κ/(κ-1) and 9-κ, and the zero-intersection anticanonical contraction locus. The present proof reproduces its same blow-up class -K_S=2H+B, the regular class Q=2H+2B/(κ-1), and all-curve positivity. The only extra explicit wording is the κ>3 singular Zariski negative coefficient and identification of the all-maximal-block regular-pencil anticanonical core. Both follow immediately from these prior published classes and contractions: -K_S-Q=((κ-3)/(κ-1))B with Q·B=0 and B²<0; and the ample all-maximal-block regular surface realizes the same null-curve contraction. No new nonstandard lemma is necessary. Thus the submitted combined original claim is substantively covered and is rejected for originality; a disclaimer or proof certificate cannot restore its novelty.
